closed: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a b : R) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (m : ℕ), a ^ (m + 1) + ((m : R) + 1) * a ^ m * (b - a) ≤ b ^ (m + 1)
informal: Tangent-line (generalised Bernoulli) inequality for powers in a linearly ordered commutative ring: for a, b ≥ 0, a^(m+1) + (m+1) a^m (b - a) ≤ b^(m+1), i.e. x^(m+1) lies above its tangent at a. Promoted from Mathlib2.gen_an_amgm_finset_ordered_ring_aux1.
